tools.name: printing.capabilities.get
tools.description: Read AIURION's supported 3D model formats, limits, materials, production options, and purchasing flow.

tools.name: printing.sessions.start
tools.description: Immediately create a public, scoped 24-hour guest session with a small free quote allowance. No account or invitation is required.

tools.name: printing.quotes.create
tools.description: Create a free 3D print quote for the selected material and actual arranged quantity. For a ChatGPT attachment, prefer the native file parameter; use fileBase64 only when the client can read the exact bytes and cannot supply a native file. Set production speed or fulfillment later with printing.quote

tools.name: printing.quotes.get
tools.description: Retrieve a quote previously created by this guest session or permanent integration.

tools.name: printing.quotes.update
tools.description: Replace the owned quote's quantity, material, production speed, or fulfillment and recalculate pricing. This overwrites the current quote configuration and invalidates its prior price approval. Any still-open checkout session for the quote or its linked build is expired; the old checkout link cannot

tools.name: printing.checkout.create
tools.description: Create an unpaid AIURION checkout link after the customer approves the current quote. This tool does not authorize, charge, or capture a payment and does not place a manufacturing order. Only if the customer later enters payment details and submits Stripe Checkout is their card authorized; AIURION c

tools.name: printing.orders.get
tools.description: Poll the payment and manufacturing status associated with a credential-owned quote.
